transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm... just here because my family made me come. They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken. But I know they're hiding my money. It's been over a year. They use bills and... fundraisers and trip plans to cover it up. I just have to keep confronting them until they tell the truth.
Have you heard any voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No. I don't... I don't hear things like that. Just... just regular things.
Aside from feeling frustrated about the money, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?
No. I don't... I'm not sad. Just tired of the lies. There's nothing wrong with my mood.
Do you have any ongoing medical conditions or physical health problems?
No. I'm fine. There's... there's nothing wrong with my health.
Have you ever felt that thoughts were being put into your head by an outside force, or taken out of your mind?
No. I... no. My thoughts are my own. I don't know why you'd ask that.
